name: parser_cursor
summary: XMLParser-shaped cursor over append-only JSONL documents. The engine pattern behind every other substrate in the MoE-chain-router stack.
engine_pattern: XMLParser API verbatim (open / read / get_node_type / get_node_name / get_node_data / get_node_offset / get_current_line / is_empty / get_attribute_count / get_attribute_name / get_attribute_value / has_attribute / get_named_attribute_value / get_named_attribute_value_safe / seek / skip_section / walk / close)

routing_connections.substrate_reads: any JSONL given via open() or open_buffer()

guarantees: Deterministic walk order — same JSONL bytes → same node offsets, every time
Append-safe — readers can walk while writers append (cursor reads up to its byte position)
Subclass-friendly — override _dict_to_node to adapt arbitrary JSON shapes
XMLParser semantics preserved — skip_section walks past current depth, seek is byte-addressable
